run_mtedx_data_prep: run the script to prepare Multilingual TEDx data for ASR or speech translation tasks
run_mtedx_joint_vocab: run the script with --joint flag to build a shared vocabulary across all language pairs
create_mtedx_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset for Multilingual TEDx audio segments with source and target utterances
process_mtedx_features: process mTEDx data to extract fbank features, generate manifests, and create vocabulary models
process_mtedx_joint_manifests: process all language pairs jointly to generate a unified vocabulary and symlinked manifests
